items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: he was playing trumpet on all the arrangements that I made for the review... That was my greatest band.

ctx.x: (Singing) This is Gayle Brockman. He could read specks, man. He's another one of these sight readers that you're playing in the first and second bar and his eyes are on the fourth and who had the Billy Williams Revue, fifth. In fact, Billie Williams, (unintelligible) thought he was God because he was playing trumpet on all the arrangements that I made for the review, and he was hitting those notes, and, oh man, he never let us down. He could always play when everybody else was tired. And he was a shy guy. He…
